CLI Reference

Complete command-line reference for every script in the repository.

Scripts

  • export_annotations.sh
  • prepare_detection_yolo_dataset.py
  • predict_and_filter.py
  • prediction_api.py
  • send_prediction_tasks.py
  • generate_other_animals.py

All scripts are run from the repository root. Arguments marked required must be supplied; others use the documented defaults.

export_annotations.sh

Shell

Helper script that exports annotations from a Label Studio project. Edit the variables inside the script (project ID, output path, etc.) before running.

bash export_annotations.sh
Note: Requires LABEL_STUDIO_TOKEN to be set in your environment or .env file.

prepare_detection_yolo_dataset.py

Python

Converts a Label Studio JSON export into a YOLO detection dataset with train/validation splits. Split membership is locked by split_tracker.json so the same images always land in the same split across re-runs.

python prepare_detection_yolo_dataset.py \
  -f annotations.json \
  -l annotations_group \
  --background \
  --compress

Arguments

ArgumentRequiredDefaultDescription
-f, --project-exported-fileYes—Path to the Label Studio JSON export.
-l, --label-byYes—Parent group name that contains the labels in each annotation.
-i, --images-dirNo—Local directory to copy images from. When provided, images are not downloaded from S3.
-e, --exclude-classesNo—Comma-separated list of class names to exclude from the dataset.
--single-classNoFalseTreat every annotated object as class 0 regardless of label.
--backgroundNoFalseInclude background images (no annotations) as roughly 10% of the dataset.
--hallucinationsNo—Directory containing hard-negative images for training.
--hallucination-ratioNo0.5Fraction (0.0–1.0) of the background budget to fill with hard negatives.
--compressNoFalseCompress images while preparing the dataset.
--compress-sizeNo1280Maximum dimension in pixels when compression is enabled.
--compress-qualityNo95JPEG quality (1–100) when compression is enabled.
--tracker-fileNosplit_tracker.jsonJSON file that records the train/val assignment for every image.
--extract-classNo—Comma-separated classes to copy into a separate folder.
--extract-dirNoother_animalsDestination folder when --extract-class is used.

Outputs

  • project_folder/ — YOLO dataset with images/train, images/val, labels/train, and labels/val.
  • dataset.yaml — YOLO dataset configuration.
  • classes.txt — Ordered class names.
  • split_tracker.json — Persistent train/val split mapping.

predict_and_filter.py

Python

High-speed batch inference over large image collections. Supports GPU acceleration, database logging, random sampling, and optional copying or visualization of detections.

python predict_and_filter.py \
  -w best.pt \
  -s /path/to/images \
  -o output_dir \
  --batch 8 \
  --db predictions.db

Arguments

ArgumentRequiredDefaultDescription
-w, --weightsYes—Path to the YOLO weights file.
-s, --sourceYes—Base directory to scan for images.
-o, --outputYes—Output directory for results.
-p, --patternNo—Glob pattern for subdirectories to scan.
-c, --confNo0.25Minimum confidence threshold for a detection.
--imgszNo1280Input size for inference.
--batchNo8Number of images processed together.
--halfNoFalseUse FP16 half-precision inference.
--dbNo—Path to an SQLite database for logging predictions and errors.
--copyNoFalseCopy detected images into the output directory.
--visualizeNoFalseSave annotated images to output_dir_visualized/.
--select-random NNo—Instantly sample N random images from the index without a full scan.
--reindexNoFalseForce a rebuild of the image index.

Outputs

  • output_dir/ — Detection metadata and/or copied images.
  • output_dir_visualized/ — Annotated images when --visualize is used.
  • predictions.db — SQLite log when --db is supplied.

prediction_api.py

Python / FastAPI

FastAPI server that exposes the trained model for Label Studio integration. The model is loaded lazily on the first request and automatically unloaded from GPU VRAM after 5 minutes of inactivity.

python prediction_api.py \
  -w best.pt \
  -m "model_v1.0" \
  -H 0.0.0.0 \
  -s 8000

Arguments

ArgumentRequiredDefaultDescription
-w, --weightsYes—Path or URL to the YOLO weights.
-m, --model-versionNo—Model name or version string for tracking.
-d, --image-dirNo—Local image directory used to avoid re-downloading images.
-H, --hostNo0.0.0.0API host address.
-s, --portNo8000API port.

Endpoint

POST /predict
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "task": { ... },
  "project": 123
}

send_prediction_tasks.py

Python

Fetches all unlabeled tasks from a Label Studio project and forwards them to the prediction API. Set LABEL_STUDIO_TOKEN in .env for authentication.

python send_prediction_tasks.py \
  --ls-url http://localhost:8080 \
  --project-id 12 \
  --ml-api-url http://localhost:8000/predict

Arguments

ArgumentRequiredDescription
--ls-urlYesURL of the Label Studio instance.
--project-idYesLabel Studio project ID.
--ml-api-urlYesFull URL of the prediction API endpoint.

generate_other_animals.py

Python

Extracts all images annotated with a specific class (for example hard negatives or non-target species) into a local folder. Images are downloaded from S3 when they are not available locally.

python generate_other_animals.py \
  -f annotations.json \
  -l annotations_group \
  -o other_animals \
  -c "other animal"

Arguments

ArgumentRequiredDefaultDescription
-f, --project-exported-fileYes—Path to the Label Studio JSON export.
-l, --label-byNolabelParent group of labels in the annotations.
-o, --output-dirNoother_animalsDestination folder for collected images.
-i, --images-dirNo—Local image directory to copy from instead of downloading from S3.
-c, --class-nameNoother animalClass name to collect.
